scripts.dev: npm run build -w @support/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @support/api" "npm run dev -w @support/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @support/contracts && npm run build -w @support/api && npm run build -w @support/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @support/contracts && npm run test -w @support/api && npm run test -w @support/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.test:db: npm run build -w @support/contracts && npm run build -w @support/api && npm run test:db -w @support/api
